text:
maria: hey infra/data — opened PR for a small warehouse-events schema change. adds `event_type` (text, nullable) + a backfill job. looking for review from infra and data team before merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repos/pull/4823

deploy-bot: CI passed — all checks ✅ (unit tests, integration, migrations smoke)

jonathan: quick q — purely additive? any index or FK changes? will migration block writes/locks?

maria: additive only. no new indexes or FKs. main migration uses `ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN` which is online on our Postgres, backfill runs separately in chunks. rollback script includes a `LOCK` to be safe but won't run in normal path.

sophia: can you paste the backfill job snippet? want to validate batching and retry logic.

maria: ```sql
-- backfill job (chunked)
WITH cte AS (
  SELECT id, compute_event_type(payload) AS event_type
  FROM events
  WHERE event_type IS NULL
  ORDER BY id
  LIMIT 5000
)
UPDATE events
SET event_type = cte.event_type
FROM cte
WHERE events.id = cte.id;
-- job sleeps 1s between chunks, respects replica lag threshold
```

sophia: looks good, does compute_event_type call external service or pure SQL? need to ensure idempotency.

maria: pure SQL/plpgsql function, idempotent. job records progress in `schema_migrations.backfill_runs` with last_id. retries safe.

kevin: tagging data-platform: tested the read path? does adding nullable column change row size impacting replication? verify replica lag during backfill.

maria: yep tested on staging, lag stayed < 5s with 5k chunk size. will throttle if lag > 30s. I can add a flag to skip backfill for low-risk deploys.

jonathan: approved from infra side after that validation. :thumbsup:

sophia: approved from data side. one follow-up: add a short note in the migration docs about backfill throttling and rollback plan.

kevin: small nit — include a db migration version in the file name for tracking. otherwise LGTM.

maria: thanks all. I'll update the PR with the doc bits and merge during the 02:00 UTC maintenance window unless anyone objects.

kevin: no objections. go for it.

maria: merging in ~30m. will post a quick alert in #incidents if we see replica lag spike.
